definitions.explanation: A dangerous or critical situation that threatens serious harm. Used for political, economic, environmental, health, and personal crises.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}{危機|きき}が{起|お}きた。
{会社|かいしゃ}は{経営|けいえい}{危機|きき}に{陥|おちい}っている。
examples.english: The company has fallen into a management crisis.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか}は{人類|じんるい}にとって{深刻|しんこく}な{危機|きき}であり、{早急|そうきゅう}な{対策|たいさく}が{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: Global warming is a serious crisis for humanity, and urgent countermeasures are called for.

notes:
A high-frequency word in news and formal discourse. The compound {危機感|ききかん} (sense of crisis) is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{危機|きき}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into a crisis
・{危機|きき}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}える: to overcome a crisis
・{危機感|ききかん}: sense of crisis
・{危機|きき}{管理|かんり}: crisis management
・{危機的|ききてき}な{状況|じょうきょう}: critical situation
